name: prep-message
description: The first turn (SPEC-13 §Prep message). Sections appear only when their body is non-empty after trimming, in the fixed order, separated by one blank line; the TASK depends on whether any skill is present.

cases.name: no-skill-minimal

setup.jd: We need a senior iOS engineer.

cases.expect:
INTERVIEW SETUP
Company: Acme
Role: Senior iOS Engineer

MY CV
Jane Doe
Swift, SwiftUI, 8 years.

JOB DESCRIPTION
We need a senior iOS engineer.

TASK
Prepare me for this interview. Give me: (1) three lines on how my background fits this role, (2) the eight questions I am most likely to be asked, each with a one-line answer angle from my CV, (3) two questions I could ask them. Keep it under 400 words. End with the line READY.
